hyperedges.name: FrmListeBase Template Pattern
hyperedges.description: FrmListeBase<T> serves as abstract template for all CRUD list forms (FrmAchats, FrmFournisseurs, FrmIngredients, FrmActivites, FrmBomContextes, FrmBomFiches). Implements workflow: load → configure columns → apply styles. Subclasses override 5 abstract members.

hyperedges.name: FrmEditBase Template Pattern
hyperedges.description: FrmEditBase serves as abstract base for all Create/Update edit forms (FrmAchatEdit, FrmFournisseurEdit, FrmIngredientEdit, FrmActiviteEdit, FrmBomContexteEdit, FrmBomFicheEdit, FrmCategorieWebEdit). Manages error provider, buttons, validation cycle.

hyperedges.name: FormHelper Utilities Network
hyperedges.description: FormHelper provides reusable UI utilities: ActiverPointDecimal (decimal separator), SelectionnerParId (combobox selection), ActiverSelectionAuFocus (select-all on focus). Used by FrmAchatEdit and FrmIngredientEdit to reduce duplication.

hyperedges.name: AppColors Centralized Palette
hyperedges.description: AppColors centralizes all UI colors (TICKET-12). Eliminates color duplication across forms. Referenced by FrmEditBase, FrmListeBase, FrmLogin, and all specialized forms. Groups: Chocolat (brand), Crème (backgrounds), Or (CTA), Neutres, Sidebar, Statuts, Shell ERP.

hyperedges.name: Nested Form Navigation Pattern
hyperedges.description: List forms open corresponding Edit forms via OuvrirFormulaire(). Supports chaining: FrmAchats → FrmAchatEdit, FrmActivites → FrmActiviteStocks, FrmBomContextes → FrmBomNiveaux → FrmBomFiches. Optional DialogResult.Retry for secondary actions (FrmAchats opens FrmIngredientEdit on Retry).
